resources.string: Hi! I\'m OYE, your personal assistant. Tell me what to do, in English, Italian or Urdu.
Microphone permission is needed to listen.
Speech recognition is not available on this device.
Add an API key in Settings to start chatting.
Limits: I can\'t force-close apps you are using, and I can\'t send WhatsApp messages until you tap Send yourself.
Oye is ready in the background
Say \"Oye\" followed by a command. Oye answers out loud. Needs the notification to stay visible.
This action has already been done or has expired.
OYE is a personal voice and chat assistant for Android. It answers in Italian, English and Urdu, and can act on your phone when you ask.

OYE uses the microphone only when you turn on listening or tap the mic. Contacts and calls are used only when you ask for them. Social media control only scrolls. It does not read, store or send posts, messages or screen text, and does not record the screen.
Control Instagram and Facebook by voice or with these buttons. Scrolling runs only after you ask for it.
On. OYE can scroll Instagram and Facebook when you ask.
Turned on in Android settings. Starting up, please wait a moment.

OYE only scrolls. It does not read, store or send your messages, posts or screen text, does not like, follow or comment, and does not record the screen. You can turn the permission off in Android settings at any time.
Limits: scrolling may not work in every app version or screen. Open the Reels feed yourself first. OYE cannot force-close other apps or choose a Reels tab for you.
Try: \"OYE, Instagram kholo.\" \"OYE, auto scroll shuru karo.\" \"OYE, agla Reel.\" \"OYE, stop.\"
Tap the OYE notification to open %1$s. Android does not let OYE open apps by itself from the background.
%1$s is not installed on this phone.
Go to the Reels tab yourself. OYE cannot see which tab is open.
Could not find the Reels tab. Please tap it yourself.
Turn on OYE social media control in Android accessibility settings first.
Auto-scroll started. Speed: %1$s. It stops after %2$d minutes.
Open Instagram or Facebook first. OYE only scrolls those two apps.
I could not scroll this screen. Open the Reels feed and try again.
I cannot see the current screen right now.
Scrolling stopped: the session time limit was reached.
Scrolling stopped: scrolling kept failing. Open the Reels feed and start again.
Scrolling stopped: accessibility access was turned off.
Scrolling Instagram or Facebook. Tap Stop to end.

Optional. Lets OYE scroll, tap a button you name, and press Back or Home when you ask. Scrolling and tapping work only in Instagram and Facebook. It does not store screen text, never taps like, follow, comment or send, and does not record the screen.
No app on this phone can open that screen.
I could not find an installed app called %s.
To change brightness, allow OYE to change system settings. I have opened that screen.
To change brightness, allow OYE to change system settings. Tap the notification to open it.
Brightness set to %d percent. I checked the new value.
Android did not accept the brightness change.
Android did not accept the volume change.
Media volume did not change. It may already be at its limit.
Sent the media key. OYE cannot confirm what the player did.
Could not send the media key.
Sent a %d minute timer to the clock app. Check that it started.
Tap the notification to set a %d minute timer.
I could not find a number for %s. Say the number, or save the contact first.
Opened the dialer. Enter the number and press call.
Tap the notification to open the dialer.
Opened the dialer for %s. Press call to ring them.
Tap the notification to open the dialer for %s.
Opened a message to %s. Read it and press Send.
Tap the notification to write a message to %s.
Tap the notification to open Downloads.
To scroll, tap, or press Back or Home, turn on OYE in Accessibility settings yourself. OYE cannot turn it on for you.
Android did not perform that action.
I found \"%s\" but it cannot be tapped.
I could not find \"%s\" on the screen.
I will not tap \"%s\" for you. Please tap it yourself.
Screen actions work only in Instagram and Facebook for now.
OYE cannot change apps you already opened or timers already set.
Reminder set for %1$d minutes from now, at %2$s.
Notifications are off for OYE, so you may not see this reminder. Allow notifications in Settings.
Oye listening stopped: the microphone permission or the Google speech service is missing.
Tap to start listening for \"Oye\" again.
A new version of OYE is ready (%s). Install it now? Android will ask you to confirm.
Download failed. Check the internet and try again.
Allow installs from OYE in the settings that just opened, then tap Install again.
Hands-free on. Just speak. Tap the mic to stop.
